name: buddie
description: Receipts for agent work: checks quotes against the bytes of their sources and repo, PR and CI claims against the repo and GitHub, without a model.
long_description:
buddie checks what an AI agent reports before you rely on it. A quotation with a link is looked up in a SHA-256 snapshot of that page; a repo anchor (`path#sha256`, `path@commit`) is checked against your checkout; `pr:` and `ci:` anchors are checked against the GitHub API. No model takes part in the check, and every check ends in a receipt anyone can re-run.

In Claude Desktop buddie runs as a local MCP server with the tools `verify_report`, `snap` and `source_text` (`summary` is listed too, with data only under Claude Code), and `environment_snapshot`, which describes the parts of this machine you granted (OS, CPU, memory, GPU, Python). Claude Code adds a hook that gates the final answer and `run:` anchors checked against the session transcript; Desktop has neither, so `run:` anchors come out as unchecked (GAPS), not as errors.

tools.name: verify_report
tools.description: Check a report: every quote in the bytes of the page it links to, every anchor in the repos or on GitHub; returns a receipt FAIL / GAPS / PASS / EMPTY.

tools.name: snap
tools.description: Snapshot URLs (bytes by SHA-256) so quotes can be taken from and checked against them.

tools.name: source_text
tools.description: Visible text of a snapshot, optionally only around a regex: copy quotes from here.

tools.name: summary
tools.description: Claude Code only: the summary of finished subagents built from the hook's journal.

tools.name: environment_snapshot
tools.description: Observe the parts of this machine a task needs (OS, CPU, memory, GPU, Python, runtimes): only the categories the person granted locally.

store.title: Snapshot folder
store.description: Where page snapshots are kept (content-addressed, reused across checks).

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Used only for pr: and ci: anchors. Without it GitHub allows 60 lookups an hour; a token with read access to the repos you work on also lets buddie check private ones.
